Traffic Advisory

Due to waterlogging, the Zakira Underpass is closed.  Today being Raksha Bandhan festival and weekend hence Commuters from Ashok Vihar, Shalimar Bagh, Pitampura, Adarsh Nagar (North West Delhi) heading towards Patel Nagar, Karol Bagh, and Moti Nagar (West Delhi) are advised:

1. Avoid Zakira Underpass
2. From Inderlok, take a left turn towards Road No. 40
3. Take a right turn towards Swami Narayan Marg 
4. Then take New Rohtak Road to reach Karol Bagh
5. From Karol Bagh, proceed to Patel Nagar, Moti Nagar  ( West Delhi) etc.

To minimize disruptions, consider using public transport, especially Delhi Metro services, which are operational. Plan your route accordingly.
